findings.source_quote: “One thing have I desired of the Lord”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Neno moja nimelitaka kwa Bwana” with “Jambo moja nimelitaka kwa Bwana” to convey “one thing,” not “one word.”

findings.source_quote: “you rise early, go to bed late”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “kwenda kulala usiku wa manane” with “kwenda kulala usiku sana” so the translation says “go to bed late” without specifying midnight.
findings.translation_quote: “mnapoamka mapema, kwenda kulala usiku wa manane”
